start.headline: Families reach out wherever they are.
start.body: A text, an email, a Facebook message. Here's how your team answers all of them from one place.

steps.alt: The team inbox with an email, a Facebook message and a text from three families
steps.title: Email, texts and Facebook in one list
steps.body: An email from the Lynch family, a Facebook message from the Santos family and a text from the Johnsons, all waiting in the same inbox.

steps.alt: Replying to the Lynch family's tuition question by email
steps.title: Reply from the same screen
steps.body: Kayla asked about tuition before her visit. Your reply goes out from the school's address, and it stays on her record.

steps.alt: The snippet picker open in the reply box
steps.title: Saved replies for the questions you get every week
steps.body: Tuition, uniforms, tour times. Write the answer once as a snippet and drop it in with two clicks. The family's name fills in on its own.

steps.alt: Contact details for the Johnson family beside the conversation
steps.title: The whole family on one screen
steps.body: Tags, contact details and where they found you sit beside the conversation, so whoever answers next knows the whole story.

finish.headline: Every message, one inbox, nothing missed.
finish.body: Your team answers faster because nobody has to check four places. The mobile app puts the same inbox on your phone.
